protocol: Astra prover -> separate fresh Astra referee (claim+report+data only; all manifest-listed files copied to referee data). Built from referee verdict.json files only; a claim is accepted iff its referee verdict is CORRECT/CORRECT_WITH_FIXES (fixes adopted in PROOF_NOTES.md §4ae). On Neil interrupt-continue (12:54): both provers were START with ncodex=0 (killed mid-run); resumed via resume_then_ref.sh with original session ids; referees auto-launched after prover EXIT 0. Monitored to completion; no relaunch of finished sessions.
headline_verified: Triangle-inclusive integer second-moment inequality (R30.M) and smallest-positive-repair constraints (R30.N): every smallest positive repaired star at K=6 retains at least 33 distal vertices (R30.Z33); ambient order at least 50 for a positive whole-star repair in a fully induced-critical positive K=6 graph (R30.F50). Relative to accepted order-40/41 theorems.

Sharp witness Q50: n=50, 2-connected triangle-free strongly C4-free, fully induced-critical, unique R_star admits zero-cut repair returning G41 with surplus 2; every vertex has rooted P13; Q50 is reducible and does not refute STAR-LEX_cap(6). Order through 49 admits no positive whole-star repair under the stated hypotheses.

Capped first distal form (R30.C33): under p(G)<=12 and |Z|=33, a smallest positive repair must have (c,m)=(8,30..33) order 42 or (9,32..33) order 43, with contracted-root path cap 10. Necessary conditions only; neither class excluded. GEN_5+T_6 (or Tprime_6) => GEN_6 (assembly).

Z_9 normal-form sharpening (R30.4a): every Z_9 counterexample must have q_A(a)=9, |A|>=254, beta in {1,2,3}. Improves R29 (|A|>=191, beta in {1..5}). Saturated-fan dichotomy (R30.2), mass envelope S<=12n-768 excluding positive charge through order 253 (R30.4), beta<=K-6 (R30.3), and beta=3 zero-block normal form (R30.7) all verified. Z_9 itself remains CONJECTURED.
Conditional assembly retained: GEN_8+T_9+Z_9^res => GEN_9; general GEN_(K-1)+T_K+Z_K => GEN_K. Controls (16 graphs / 687 roots), A40/A157, ring FIX-RING replayed and verified under both sessions.
open: T_6 / Tprime_6 / STAR-LEX_cap(6) as universal assertions on 2-connected (or general) irreducible positive strongly C4-free graphs; Q50 shows the Z33/F50 bounds are sharp for whole-star repair but is reducible; capped forms (8,30..33)/(9,32..33) not yet excluded
Z_9 / RB_9 / C_9 (sharpened: q=9, n>=254, beta in {1,2,3}); no counterexample found; residual unbounded class open
GEN_K (K>=6) beyond accepted prior results; GEN_6 counterexample-order lower bound remains 42

claims.reason: The two forbidden ordered-pair lists overlap in exactly 2 theta pairs. Neighborhood matchings imply d^2-(d-t)^2 >=3t; summation yields the -3 tau term before integer convexity. Independently tested arbitrary disjoint C0,W, without safety.

Singleton losses give the displayed inequalities; one original parent would realize a positive proper induced subgraph. The k lower bound forces z>0. Since m<=z, A_K>0 and the 3 theta increments absorb the -2 theta correction.

claims.reason: A triangle vertex has degree at least u+1. Summing neighbor degrees and subtracting d_v+2t_v gives the exact C count. The strongly C4-free hypothesis in the claim index is essential and is respected.

claims.reason: Equality forces d=4,C=12,Z=33, root triangle count zero, four degree-four neighbors and surplus 1 or 2; triangle-free parity forces 2. Formula (7) gives (15). These facts do not exclude capped positive graphs of orders 42-49.

claims.reason: The accepted capped order bound and 3c<=33 give c=8..11. Exact integer moments eliminate c=10,11 and the smaller m values. The strict one-unit comparison 1057>1056 is valid. These are necessary forms, with no realization or exclusion claim.

claims.statement: Unextendible rooted terminal: non-cutness and the degree, loss and lambda inequalities
claims.reason: Every outside neighbor must meet the previous path. Uniqueness of common neighbors allows at most one contact per old position; the distance-two position is forbidden. The predecessor contributes precisely eta. Subtracting triangle terms proves L<=2r-4 and lambda<=r-2. A component separated by deleting the terminal would give an extension. The r=2 cases give L=2 or 1.

claims.statement: Saturated-fan dichotomy for every integer Q>=4
claims.reason: Failure of the cheap alternative forces maximal order Q and terminal type (Q-2,0) or (Q-1,1). Saturation injects Q-3 outside neighbors into exactly Q-3 available positions; no contact can be shared or wasted. The optional predecessor-triangle neighbor cannot consume one of those positions. This forces the claimed chord exclusions and validates every rotation. Extending a shortest root-to-w path proves the endpoint assertion. The radius-two neighbor count gives the stated mass inequality.

claims.statement: Petersen and two-Petersen sharpness controls
claims.reason: Direct reconstruction and rooted path enumeration give q=5, with mass 30 and 60 respectively; both bounds are equalities. The Petersen proper-subset inequalities and pentagon contraction bound also independently establish rooted minimality, hence arbitrary-model irreducibility of its two-copy amalgam.

claims.statement: Positive short-root charge satisfies beta<=K-6
claims.reason: The mass alternative is strictly below K(n-1), contradicting positive charge. The cheap alternative and the off-root singleton bound give K+beta<=2K-6. No lower induction or model condition is used by this lemma itself.

claims.statement: q>=min(K+2,ceil((K+beta)/2)+3) for normalized rooted graphs
claims.reason: Singleton loss first excludes rooted maximum at most three. When q<=K+1, positive K-charge excludes the mass alternative with Q=q. The resulting K+beta<=2q-6 gives the ceiling correctly.

claims.statement: Fully induced-critical capped cut-vertex graphs satisfy epsilon<=K-6
claims.reason: Each branch has charge alpha>=epsilon>0 and retains the loss bound at every nonattachment vertex. If epsilon>=K-5, the dichotomy forces q>=K+1 in every branch. Two different branches are anticomplete away from their common root, so their paths concatenate to order 2K+1.

claims.statement: Mass envelope S<=12n-768 and a9<=3n-759; no positive charge through order 253
claims.reason: At n=190 the accepted base is 1512. The mass branch is below the line by 4(n-190); otherwise deletion of a nonroot non-cut terminal loses at most 12 and preserves the rooted cap. Induction and the subtraction of 9(n-1) are correct. Smaller orders use the accepted ROOT results, not this induction.

claims.statement: Every Z9 counterexample has q=9, n>=254, beta in {1,2,3}
claims.reason: Combines the accepted normalization and q>=9 with R30.3 and R30.4. It retains p<=18 and both original all-model hypotheses. It does not assert that any such graph exists.

claims.statement: Amplification orders 2531/1266/1013 and original critical cut-graph order at least 334
claims.reason: For beta=1,2,3 the copy counts floor(9/beta)+1 are 10,5,4. Orders are m(254-1)+1 and surpluses m beta-9. These are correctly restricted to the identical-block construction. In any original critical cut graph, at most one branch can start P10; a short positive branch has order at least 254 and another positive branch at least 81, giving 334.

claims.statement: Cheap terminal types, minimum path orders, and nonadjacency to the root
claims.reason: Enumerating the integer degree/triangle constraints with d<=8 and eta=1 when d=8 gives exactly the stated table. The inherited lambda bounds and lambda<=r-2 give path order at least 7 or 8; these endpoints cannot be adjacent to the root.

claims.statement: Zero star capacities at every center in N[a], with exact safety and triangle corrections
claims.reason: Re-derived the quotient count: its edges contribute 2e(Z)+2e(C,Z)+2|C|+2e(C), and its triangles contribute T(Z)+sum_c e(N_Z(c))+e(C). Subtracting 9(|C|+|Z|) yields formula (10). Safety excludes all other new C4s and triangle types. Every star bag contains a and is proper, so componentwise maxima are nonpositive and the empty choice makes each zero.

claims.statement: Under GEN8, A minus the root and cheap terminal contains P17
claims.reason: The neighbor-lambda sum yields n-1>=s d(a). Deleting the root gives epsilon8>=beta+(s-2)d+3t. Nonadjacency of x to a preserves its degree and triangles; deleting x decreases epsilon8 by at most four. The minimum lower bound is three, so GEN8 supplies P17. No attachment conclusion is made.

claims.statement: Charge-three zero-block normal form and four attachment lists
claims.reason: The terminal is nontriangular of degree six and H=A-x has charge zero. Each block is obtainable as a rooted model, so nonpositive block charges summing to zero are individually zero; bridges are impossible. Accepted ROOT bounds give a rooted P9 at every block vertex, so a block not containing a would yield a rooted P10. The envelope forces block order at least 253. Deleting each block interior gives excess loss 2ki>=3. Sum ki=6 gives precisely the four lists and their order bounds. Model restrictions/composition justify all inheritances.

claims.statement: Degree-six 2-degeneracy and degree-five independence
claims.reason: The singleton loss excludes every triangle at a nonroot degree-six or degree-five vertex. For degree-six sets, D(U)=12|U|-2e(U), giving 2e(U)<=3|U|-beta; every induced subgraph therefore has average degree below three. Degree five forces beta=1, and the two-vertex deletion inequality excludes an edge.

claims.reason: Independently enumerated subsets and partitions of the seven possible contact positions, with every allowed matching. The ordering by minimum contact is complete and unique because contact sets are disjoint. Reconstructed every graph, filtered strong C4-freeness and loss, and obtained exactly the supplied 151 keys. Also checked the H21 proper model with surplus three. These flow certificates do not by themselves prove arbitrary-model irreducibility.

Checked disjoint pentagon matchings on every edge, then independently enumerated all such pentagons and solved each packing problem exactly. The representative argument bounds every contracting quotient by 35<36, including arbitrary connected bags and deletions. Together these certify both model conditions. If it retains the root, root-bag intersections with copies are connected. A proper model has at least one proper restriction, giving surplus at most 3*2-6=0. Exact A40 maxima and the verified bouquet decomposition give p=39, central q=20. Every pentagon stays in a block, so rho=4 as well.

Re-derived full criticality from the connected even-regular core cut identity. Independently solved and verified the relaxed flow bounds at all 270 roots for L=2..5; the accepted remote-module flow-extension proof preserves the bound for larger L. Exact G2 enumeration gives p=22 and rho=0.

Charge-three blocks have charge zero and cannot be fed to positive-charge Z9. The universal arguments use no fixed-path exchange, one-edge completeness, or simultaneous endpoint deletion. claims.statement: Z9, its unbounded residual class, GEN8, T9, GEN9 and REAL-133
